definitions.explanation: The count or total of people in a group or at an event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧{人数|にんずう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→くださる：01305_kudasaru⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me the number of participants.

examples.japanese: {人数|にんずう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦すぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
{人数|にんずう}⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I ordered lunches for everyone (the number of people).

notes:
COMPOUND: ⟦{人|にん}→人：00658_nin⟧ (person) + ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {人数|にんずう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧ (count the number of people)
- {人数|にんずう}⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧ (capacity limit)
- {人数|にんずう}⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (for the number of people)
- ⟦{最低|さいてい}→最低：01412_saitei⟧{人数|にんずう} (minimum number of people)

PRONUNCIATION NOTE: にんずう is the standard reading. にんず is also sometimes used.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{定員|ていいん}→定員：04532_teiin⟧ (capacity, fixed number of people)
- ⟦{人員|じんいん}→人員：17843_jinin⟧ (personnel, staff)
- ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧ (population)
